reason: The free part already does what I need, and the paid part only matters if it reads my K PLUS and card statements properly. I'd try the free trial, but I wouldn't pay anything until I've seen it work on my own slips and statement, and I'm not convinced a new app should be reading my bank data.
objection: I don't know if it works with my bank or my card, and I'm not sure I want my bank slips going through an app I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my own K PLUS slip and my card statement read correctly during the free trial, with a clear explanation of what gets stored and how it is encrypted.
